hero.title: Your customer's phone rings when the order is ready.
hero.body: Customers scan a QR code, order from your menu, and wait anywhere. Tap Ready and their phone calls them back. No app, no pagers, no crowd at the counter.

login.title: Log in to your shop
login.body: Use your email and password, or get a one-time link.

signup.title: Create your shop
signup.body: Your page is ready to set up as soon as your plan is active.
signup.terms: By creating an account you accept the <terms>terms</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

fields.shopNameHint: As customers know it, e.g. Café El Bahdja

method.label: How do you want to sign in?

magic.sentBody: We sent a sign-in link to {email}. It works once and expires in one hour.

confirm.title: Confirm your email
confirm.body: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish creating your shop.

errors.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password: at least 8 characters.
errors.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.

pending_payment.title: Activate your plan to open the shop
pending_payment.body: Everything is set up and waiting. Choose a plan to unlock your page, menu and QR codes.

past_due.title: Payment overdue: shop stays open until {date}
past_due.body: Renew before then to keep taking orders.

suspended.title: Your shop is offline
suspended.body: Customers see a “temporarily unavailable” page. Renew your plan to reopen.

canceled.title: Your subscription has ended
canceled.body: Your menu and history are kept. Subscribe again to reopen.

account.readOnly: Read-only until your plan is active.

setup.shop: Set your shop page: name, link, logo, colors

start.title: Name your shop
start.body: This account isn't linked to a shop yet. Create one, or open the invitation link your manager sent you.

pending.title: Coming in the next build phase
pending.body: This section is planned and its data model is already in place.

merchants.title: Merchants
merchants.results: {count, plural, =0 {No merchants match} one {# merchant} other {# merchants}}
merchants.suspendBody: Customers will see a “temporarily unavailable” page and the owner’s dashboard turns read-only.
merchants.reactivateBody: The shop goes live again if its paid period is still running; otherwise it waits for payment.

payments.title: Payments
payments.pendingEmpty: Nothing to review. New manual receipts appear here.
payments.rejectPlaceholder: e.g. The amount doesn’t match the invoice

plans.title: Plans
plans.help: Prices apply to new invoices. Existing paid periods are not affected.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.mrr: Monthly revenue from active paid plans

errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

current.changePlan: Switch to this plan at renewal

plans.heading: Choose a plan

pay.heading: Pay for {plan}
pay.chargilyHint: Secure checkout by Chargily Pay. You come back here when it’s done.
pay.manualHint: Send the payment, then upload the receipt. We activate your account after checking it, usually within one working day.
pay.mockHint: Development only: simulates a gateway, including its signed confirmation.
pay.trialHint: No payment now. Your shop goes live immediately.

manual.cash: Cash is accepted at our office against a receipt.
manual.receipt: Receipt: photo or PDF, up to 5 MB
manual.pending: Receipt received on {date}. We’re checking it; your plan activates as soon as it’s approved.
manual.rejected: Your last receipt was not accepted: {note}
manual.rejectedNoNote: Your last receipt was not accepted. Send a clearer copy or contact support.

checkout.success: Payment sent. Your plan activates as soon as the payment provider confirms it, usually within a minute.
checkout.failed: The payment didn’t go through and nothing was charged. You can try again.

invoices.heading: Invoices
invoices.empty: No invoices yet. They appear here once you pay.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel your subscription?
cancelDialog.body: Your shop stays open until {date}. After that, customers see a “temporarily unavailable” page. Your menu and history are kept.
cancelDialog.bodyNow: Your shop goes offline now. Your menu and history are kept.

mock.title: Test checkout
mock.body: This page stands in for a payment gateway during development. Choose what the gateway reports; the result arrives through a signed webhook, as in production.
mock.unavailable: This payment is no longer waiting for checkout.

errors.forbidden: Only the shop owner can manage billing.
errors.plan_unavailable: That plan is no longer offered. Pick another one.
errors.provider_unavailable: This payment method isn’t available right now. Try another one.
errors.trial_already_used: Your shop has already used its free trial.
errors.trial_not_available: A free trial isn’t available for this account.
errors.not_cancelable: There is no running subscription to cancel.
errors.nothing_to_revert: Your subscription isn’t scheduled to end.
errors.receipt_too_large: The receipt is larger than 5 MB. Send a smaller photo or PDF.
errors.receipt_bad_type: Send the receipt as a JPG, PNG, WebP photo or a PDF.
errors.already_pending: A receipt is already waiting for review.

activated.subject: {shop} is live on {brand}

renewed.subject: Payment received for {shop}
renewed.body: Thank you. Your plan for {shop} has been renewed.

trial_started.subject: Your free trial for {shop} has started
trial_started.body: {shop} is live for the length of your trial. Choose a plan any time to keep it running.

trial_expired.subject: The free trial for {shop} has ended
trial_expired.body: {shop} is offline until you choose a plan. Your menu is kept.

past_due.subject: Payment overdue for {shop}
past_due.body: The plan period for {shop} has ended. The shop stays open for a few more days; renew to keep taking orders.

suspended.subject: {shop} is offline
suspended.body: {shop} is no longer visible to customers. Renew your plan to reopen it.

canceled.subject: The subscription for {shop} has ended
canceled.body: {shop} is offline. Your menu and history are kept if you come back.

reactivated.subject: {shop} is back online
reactivated.body: The plan for {shop} is active again and customers can order.

paymentRejected.subject: Your payment receipt needs attention · {brand}
paymentRejected.body: We couldn’t approve the receipt you sent for {shop}.
